validationContract.model: init_reduce, all_reduce, row_reduce_small, row_reduce_simple, row_reduce_looped, col_reduce_small, col_reduce_longcolumn, col_reduce_looped and col_reduce_2pass step by step: thread loops, guarded loads, SIMD-group shuffle-down trees, threadgroup combines and guarded stores; checked against a left fold of each output

comparison.default: exact words; a NaN result accepts any NaN
comparison.orderFreeReductions: types narrower than 8 bytes reduce with Apple's SIMD-group intrinsics; their inputs make every fold order give the same words
comparison.kernelOrderReductions: 8-byte types reduce with the explicit shuffle loop; complex products keep the zero signs of the kernel's own order

openglIndexRangeAssertions.expression: in_ + elem_to_loc_int64_t(out_idx, shape, strides, ndim) + int64(lid.x) * REDUCE_N_READS

layout.output: every element starts different from its expected result

inputs.integers: unsigned sums and products wrap; signed sums and products keep every partial result of every order inside the output type
inputs.logical: true is any nonzero bit pattern, NaN included; -0.0 is false
inputs.extrema: one zero sign per output; NaN pairs for complex64
